C0541.title: Beijing Woman Swapped 121 Clothing Orders with Used Items to Fraudulently Obtain Over 20,000 Yuan in Refunds, Detained
C0541.summary: A woman in Beijing placed 121 clothing orders across multiple e-commerce platforms, then returned used garments in place of the new items to fraudulently obtain over 20,000 yuan in refunds. Police found a large quantity of unopened new clothing and records of abusive returns at her residence. She has been criminally detained on suspicion of fraud.

references.title: Caught for Repeated Malicious Refunds: A Vivid Lesson in Rule of Law
